scope: Camera-only fixed estimated-extrinsic sensitivity configurations and production archive/label interfaces. No new physical camera motion or vibration.

configurations.baseline: Zero camera residual, retaining the input configuration's other noise and calibration settings
configurations.combination: one component at a time; rotation vectors about the optical origin

validation.production_calibration_archive: All 37 cases call MeasurementAdapter.publish_calibration with a captured TF sink; independent body-axis checks verify translation/rotation magnitudes and signs. All calibration IDs distinct; non-camera frames and input baseline unchanged.
validation.production_capture_labels: 0 and 180 degree body yaw: a +3 mm camera lever-arm residual produces opposite map-X shifts. Replacing raw truth camera positions does not change estimated labels.
validation.generator: Two fresh output directories are byte-identical. Reusing an output directory fails without overwriting existing files.

build_note: The initial targeted test could not import the newly added module from the stale installed package. Rebuilt agv_localization before the final passing standard test run.
not_claimed: new GUI or moving-vehicle capture validation
